title: An Artin group with no geometric CAT(0) action
summary: We construct an Artin group on 116 generators that admits no proper, cocompact isometric action on a nonempty proper CAT(0) space. This refutes the CAT(0) conjecture for Artin groups.
family_title: Classifying spaces and geometric obstructions for Artin groups

review.reason: Constructs an Artin group with no proper cocompact CAT(0) action, refuting a conjecture.
